newsitem.title: UK: Anglo has no plans for Ashanti.
newsitem.headline: Anglo has no plans for Ashanti.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd has no plans for its indirect stake in Ashanti Goldfields, Anglo's deputy chairman said on Tuesday.

But the biggest gold producer in the world would like to develop its relationship with the Ghanaian firm and perhaps end up collaborating on joint projects," Deputy Chairman Nicky Oppenheimer told Reuters on the sidelines of an investment conference in London.
Anglo recently raised its stake to 28 percent in Britain's Lonrho plc, which in turn holds 33.6 percent of Ashanti.
Industry sources have said that the Ghana government would oppose any moves by Anglo to forge a link with Ashanti, using its golden share to prevent a tie-up.
"We don't have any plans for Ashanti," Oppenheimer said.
"What we would like to do is establish a good relationship with Ashanti...do joint ventures with Sam Jonah and Ashanti," he added, referring to Ashanti's chief executive.
A recent meeting between Anglo executives in Ghana with Jonah and Ghanaian President Jerry Rawlings went well, Oppenheimer said.
Anglo was in no hurry, however, and was prepared to go slowly in developing a relationship with Ashanti.
"These are things that are wait and see," he added.
